infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Ahia to use your microphone only during in-app voice calls you start or accept.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Ahia to use Face ID to confirm payments.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Ahia to select product and receipt photos.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Ahia to take photos of products and receipts.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Ahia to use your microphone only during in-app voice calls you start or accept.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Ahia to find nearby sellers, set collection pins and share delivery location.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow location during active delivery work, including when the app is in the background. You can turn this off in Drive.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Ahia to scan delivery handover codes.

android.extraProguardRules:
# react-native-webrtc: keep the WebRTC Java classes (called from native code) and ignore
# optional decoders that aren't shipped, e.g. org.webrtc.Dav1dDecoder.
-keep class org.webrtc.** { *; }
-dontwarn org.webrtc.**
